name: Run trace production acceptance
# Explicit operator runs only. Preflight reads configuration; execute uses the
# existing tagged account and fixed small subscription models for issue #1512.
# controlled-failure uses only an owned loopback database and 20 test failures.
on:
  workflow_dispatch:
    inputs:
      mode:
        description: Preflight, bounded real tasks, native PNG export, or 20 isolated failures
        type: choice
        options: [preflight, execute, export, controlled-failure]
        default: preflight
      expected-deployment-sha:
        description: Exact main commit; already served for production acceptance and export
        type: string
        required: true
      model-case:
        description: Subscription model case
        type: choice
        options: [all, claude, codex]
        default: all
      prepare:
        description: Temporarily prepare and restore idle account settings through normal APIs
        type: boolean
        default: false
      browser-submit:
        description: Submit one model case once through the runner's real browser New task UI
        type: boolean
        default: false
      export-target:
        description: Native saved PostHog object to export after verifying production evidence
        type: choice
        options: [dashboard, insight]
        default: dashboard
      export-id:
        description: Positive numeric PostHog object ID; required only for export
        type: string
        required: false
      session-id:
        description: Optional real browser Replay UUID; requires trace-id and export mode
        type: string
        required: false
      trace-id:
        description: Matching actual APM trace hex ID; requires session-id and export mode
        type: string
        required: false
permissions:
  contents: read
concurrency:
  group: run-trace-production-acceptance
  cancel-in-progress: false
  queue: max
jobs:
  acceptance:
    if: github.repository == 'alexj11324/Mikka' && github.ref == 'refs/heads/main' && (inputs.mode == 'preflight' || inputs.mode == 'execute')
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 25
    permissions:
      contents: read
      id-token: write
      issues: write
    env:
      MIKKA_EXPECTED_DEPLOYMENT_SHA: ${{ inputs.expected-deployment-sha }}
      MIKKA_OBSERVABILITY_MODEL_CASE: ${{ inputs.model-case }}
      ACCEPTANCE_MODE: ${{ inputs.mode }}
      ACCEPTANCE_PREPARE: ${{ inputs.prepare }}
      ACCEPTANCE_BROWSER_SUBMIT: ${{ inputs.browser-submit }}
      REPLAY_SESSION_ID: ${{ inputs.session-id }}
      REPLAY_TRACE_ID: ${{ inputs.trace-id }}
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@11d5960a326750d5838078e36cf38b85af677262 # v4
        with:
          persist-credentials: false
      - uses: actions/setup-node@49933ea5288caeca8642d1e84afbd3f7d6820020 # v4
        with:
          node-version: 24
      - name: Bind acceptance to this exact main revision
        run: |
          node --input-type=module - <<'JS'
          import assert from 'node:assert/strict'
          assert.match(process.env.MIKKA_EXPECTED_DEPLOYMENT_SHA ?? '', /^[a-f0-9]{40}$/)
          assert.equal(process.env.MIKKA_EXPECTED_DEPLOYMENT_SHA, process.env.GITHUB_SHA)
          assert.ok(['preflight', 'execute'].includes(process.env.ACCEPTANCE_MODE))
          assert.ok(process.env.ACCEPTANCE_MODE === 'execute' || (process.env.ACCEPTANCE_PREPARE !== 'true' && process.env.ACCEPTANCE_BROWSER_SUBMIT !== 'true'))
          assert.ok(process.env.ACCEPTANCE_BROWSER_SUBMIT !== 'true' || process.env.MIKKA_OBSERVABILITY_MODEL_CASE !== 'all')
          assert.ok(!process.env.REPLAY_SESSION_ID && !process.env.REPLAY_TRACE_ID)
          JS
      - name: Verify the acceptance guards before loading credentials
        run: node --test scripts/acceptance/run-observability.test.mjs scripts/acceptance/run-observability-workflow.test.mjs scripts/acceptance/run-observability-browser.test.mjs
      - name: Set up the pinned package manager for the optional browser
        if: inputs.browser-submit
        uses: pnpm/action-setup@b906affcce14559ad1aafd4ab0e942779e9f58b1 # v4
        with:
          version: 10.34.3
      - name: Install locked Chromium before loading account credentials
        if: inputs.browser-submit
        env:
          ELECTRON_SKIP_BINARY_DOWNLOAD: '1'
        run: |
          pnpm install --frozen-lockfile --ignore-scripts
          node --input-type=module - <<'JS'
          import assert from 'node:assert/strict'
          import { createRequire } from 'node:module'
          const require = createRequire(import.meta.url)
          assert.equal(require('@playwright/test/package.json').version, '1.64.1')
          JS
          pnpm exec playwright install --with-deps chromium
      - name: Read the existing production acceptance account
        uses: Infisical/secrets-action@d2e351f16c6ca20d17c85e6c992e04bdeb64e87d # v1.0.18
        with:
          method: oidc
          identity-id: 2cf9fa19-b9db-4c08-8ca0-b31859f2cbac
          oidc-audience: mikka-infisical
          project-id: 89850d6a-f020-4936-863e-df77380dfe40
          env-slug: prod
          secret-path: /
          secret-name: ACME_DEMO_EMAIL
          include-imports: false
      - name: Read the account password inside this runner
        uses: Infisical/secrets-action@d2e351f16c6ca20d17c85e6c992e04bdeb64e87d # v1.0.18
        with:
          method: oidc
          identity-id: 2cf9fa19-b9db-4c08-8ca0-b31859f2cbac
          oidc-audience: mikka-infisical
          project-id: 89850d6a-f020-4936-863e-df77380dfe40
          env-slug: prod
          secret-path: /
          secret-name: ACME_DEMO_PASSWORD
          include-imports: false
      - name: Run bounded production acceptance
        env:
          MIKKA_ACCEPTANCE_PROGRESS_TOKEN: ${{ github.token }}
        run: |
          args=()
          if [ "$ACCEPTANCE_MODE" = execute ]; then
            args+=(--execute)
          fi
          if [ "$ACCEPTANCE_PREPARE" = true ]; then args+=(--prepare); fi
          if [ "$ACCEPTANCE_BROWSER_SUBMIT" = true ]; then args+=(--browser-submit --runner-browser); fi
          node scripts/acceptance/run-observability-workflow.mjs "${args[@]}"
      - name: Preserve only the safe acceptance report
        if: always()
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@ea165f8d65b6e75b540449e92b4886f43607fa02 # v4
        with:
          name: run-trace-acceptance-${{ github.run_id }}
          path: |
            production-run-observability-report/report.json
            production-run-observability-report/recovery.json
            production-run-observability-report/browser-actor.receipt.json
          retention-days: 7
          if-no-files-found: warn
  controlled-failure:
    if: github.repository == 'alexj11324/Mikka' && github.ref == 'refs/heads/main' && inputs.mode == 'controlled-failure'
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 10
    permissions:
      contents: read
      id-token: write
    env:
      MIKKA_EXPECTED_DEPLOYMENT_SHA: ${{ inputs.expected-deployment-sha }}
      ACCEPTANCE_MODE: ${{ inputs.mode }}
      ACCEPTANCE_PREPARE: ${{ inputs.prepare }}
      ACCEPTANCE_BROWSER_SUBMIT: ${{ inputs.browser-submit }}
      ACCEPTANCE_MODEL_CASE: ${{ inputs.model-case }}
      EXPORT_TARGET: ${{ inputs.export-target }}
      EXPORT_ID: ${{ inputs.export-id }}
      REPLAY_SESSION_ID: ${{ inputs.session-id }}
      REPLAY_TRACE_ID: ${{ inputs.trace-id }}
      E2E_DATABASE_URL: postgresql://e2e:e2e-local-only@127.0.0.1:5432/mikka_e2e
      ELECTRON_SKIP_BINARY_DOWNLOAD: '1'
    services:
      postgres:
        image: postgres:17
        env:
          POSTGRES_USER: e2e
          POSTGRES_PASSWORD: e2e-local-only
          POSTGRES_DB: mikka_e2e
        ports:
          - 127.0.0.1:5432:5432
        options: >-
          --health-cmd "pg_isready -U e2e -d mikka_e2e"
          --health-interval 5s --health-timeout 5s --health-retries 10
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@11d5960a326750d5838078e36cf38b85af677262 # v4
        with:
          ref: ${{ github.sha }}
          persist-credentials: false
      - uses: actions/setup-node@49933ea5288caeca8642d1e84afbd3f7d6820020 # v4
        with:
          node-version: 24
      - name: Bind the isolated probe to this exact main revision
        run: |
          test "$(git rev-parse HEAD)" = "$GITHUB_SHA"
          node --input-type=module - <<'JS'
          import assert from 'node:assert/strict'
          assert.match(process.env.MIKKA_EXPECTED_DEPLOYMENT_SHA ?? '', /^[a-f0-9]{40}$/)
          assert.equal(process.env.MIKKA_EXPECTED_DEPLOYMENT_SHA, process.env.GITHUB_SHA)
          assert.equal(process.env.ACCEPTANCE_MODE, 'controlled-failure')
          assert.notEqual(process.env.ACCEPTANCE_PREPARE, 'true')
          assert.notEqual(process.env.ACCEPTANCE_BROWSER_SUBMIT, 'true')
          assert.equal(process.env.ACCEPTANCE_MODEL_CASE, 'all')
          assert.equal(process.env.EXPORT_TARGET, 'dashboard')
          assert.ok(!process.env.EXPORT_ID && !process.env.REPLAY_SESSION_ID && !process.env.REPLAY_TRACE_ID)
          JS
      - uses: pnpm/action-setup@b906affcce14559ad1aafd4ab0e942779e9f58b1 # v4
        with:
          version: 10.34.3
      - name: Install locked dependencies before loading the project token
        run: pnpm install --frozen-lockfile --ignore-scripts
      - name: Verify the isolated export and workflow guards before credentials
        run: node --import ./scripts/server-test.mjs --import tsx --test scripts/ops/run-trace-benchmark.test.ts
      - name: Measure current-source overhead with the local memory exporters
        run: |
          mkdir -p production-run-observability-report
          node --import ./scripts/server-test.mjs --import tsx scripts/ops/run-trace-benchmark.ts > production-run-observability-report/overhead.receipt.json
      - name: Read only the existing PostHog project ingestion token
        uses: Infisical/secrets-action@d2e351f16c6ca20d17c85e6c992e04bdeb64e87d # v1.0.18
        with:
          method: oidc
          identity-id: 2cf9fa19-b9db-4c08-8ca0-b31859f2cbac
          oidc-audience: mikka-infisical
          project-id: 89850d6a-f020-4936-863e-df77380dfe40
          env-slug: prod
          secret-path: /vercel
          secret-name: NEXT_PUBLIC_POSTHOG_KEY
          include-imports: false
      - name: Export exactly 20 ordinary controlled failures from the isolated database
        run: node --import ./scripts/server-test.mjs --import tsx scripts/ops/run-trace-benchmark.ts --export-controlled-failures
      - name: Preserve the safe callback receipt for separate backend verification
        if: always()
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@ea165f8d65b6e75b540449e92b4886f43607fa02 # v4
        with:
          name: run-trace-controlled-failure-${{ github.run_id }}
          path: |
            production-run-observability-report/controlled-failure.receipt.json
            production-run-observability-report/overhead.receipt.json
          retention-days: 7
          if-no-files-found: warn
  export:
    if: github.repository == 'alexj11324/Mikka' && github.ref == 'refs/heads/main' && inputs.mode == 'export'
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 8
    permissions:
      contents: read
      id-token: write
    env:
      EXPECTED_DEPLOYMENT_SHA: ${{ inputs.expected-deployment-sha }}
      EXPORT_TARGET: ${{ inputs.export-target }}
      EXPORT_ID: ${{ inputs.export-id }}
      REPLAY_SESSION_ID: ${{ inputs.session-id }}
      REPLAY_TRACE_ID: ${{ inputs.trace-id }}
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@11d5960a326750d5838078e36cf38b85af677262 # v4
        with:
          persist-credentials: false
      - uses: actions/setup-node@49933ea5288caeca8642d1e84afbd3f7d6820020 # v4
        with:
          node-version: 24
      - name: Validate the immutable source and numeric export target
        run: |
          node --input-type=module - <<'JS'
          import assert from 'node:assert/strict'
          import { parseArguments } from './scripts/ops/posthog-export-evidence.mjs'
          import { optionalReplayOptions } from './scripts/ops/posthog-replay-evidence.mjs'
          assert.match(process.env.EXPECTED_DEPLOYMENT_SHA ?? '', /^[a-f0-9]{40}$/)
          assert.equal(process.env.EXPECTED_DEPLOYMENT_SHA, process.env.GITHUB_SHA)
          parseArguments([`--${process.env.EXPORT_TARGET}`, process.env.EXPORT_ID])
          optionalReplayOptions(process.env.REPLAY_SESSION_ID, process.env.REPLAY_TRACE_ID)
          JS
      - name: Verify the offline export guards before loading credentials
        run: node --test scripts/ops/posthog-export-evidence.test.mjs scripts/ops/posthog-replay-evidence.test.mjs
      - name: Read the existing PostHog key inside this runner
        uses: Infisical/secrets-action@d2e351f16c6ca20d17c85e6c992e04bdeb64e87d # v1.0.18
        with:
          method: oidc
          identity-id: 2cf9fa19-b9db-4c08-8ca0-b31859f2cbac
          oidc-audience: mikka-infisical
          project-id: 89850d6a-f020-4936-863e-df77380dfe40
          env-slug: prod
          secret-path: /platform
          secret-name: POSTHOG_PERSONAL_API_KEY
          include-imports: false
      - name: Export the actual saved PostHog view
        run: node scripts/ops/posthog-export-evidence.mjs "--$EXPORT_TARGET" "$EXPORT_ID"
      - name: Read one actual Replay segment into a safe receipt
        if: inputs.session-id != ''
        run: node scripts/ops/posthog-replay-evidence.mjs --session-id "$REPLAY_SESSION_ID" --trace-id "$REPLAY_TRACE_ID"
      - name: Preserve the native PNG and safe evidence receipts
        if: always()
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@ea165f8d65b6e75b540449e92b4886f43607fa02 # v4
        with:
          name: run-trace-posthog-${{ github.run_id }}
          path: |
            production-run-observability-report/posthog-*.png
            production-run-observability-report/posthog-*.receipt.json
          retention-days: 7
          if-no-files-found: warn
